notes: Corrected: the first בְּ (s010) had been given *it be* under rule 49. Rule 49 governs only a phrase for which the ASV has written an English preposition, and none is written here, so the preposition is unrepresented under rule 40 and the copula with its dummy subject joins the predicate nominal under rule 20. All four בְּ of the verse are now read alike.
The four אוֹ are counted against the ASV's *Or ... whether ... or ... or*, one English connective per morpheme, so rule 14's correlative-pair clause is not reached.
אֲשֶׁר takes the conditional *if*: a subordinating morpheme stands in the clause, so rule 55's added case does not apply.
